title: Te Āroha i roto i ngā Pari
intro: Whakaarohia he awaawa kei reira ngā whare e keria ana i ngā pari, ā, e mau ana te hau i te mahara o tētahi whakatūpato kāore i whakarongohia. I mua, i tupu pai tētahi iwi i konei, i manaakitia engari i whakakeke, tae noa ki te putanga mai o tētahi tohu i te toka tonu i whakawhirinakihia e rātou.
clues: He iwi mātou i hanga kāinga haumaru i ngā maunga, i noho haumaru hoki i roto i ō mātou kāinga toka.
I noho mātou i te whenua mania, i te whenua kōhatu, i manaakitia ki ngā māra me ngā puna wai.
I tae mai tētahi karere i waenganui i a mātou, e karanga ana kia whakarērea ō mātou atua teka, kia karakia ki te Kaihanga Kotahi pono.
I whakakake mātou ki te whakatakoto i tētahi tikanga mō te whakapono: he tohu ahurei ka puta ake i ngā toka tonu i keria e mātou.
I te putanga mai o te kamera uha i oatitia mai i roto i te toka, he tohu mārama, i whakakahore tonu tō tātou hunga rangatira, ā, i whakamomori i a ia ahakoa te whakatūpato mō te aituā e tata mai ana.
E toru ngā rā i muri i tā mātou mahi, ka haruru te whatitiri nui puta noa i te awaawa, ā, kua hinga mātou hei puranga paru, ko ō mātou kāinga hei urupā.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verse: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting. (27:45)
